<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR optimizes e2e test execution by removing the Ray mini image build dependency from five test targets and making the Ray image pull unconditional in the Docker image preparation script.

## Changes

**E2E test target Ray image optimization**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Remove Ray mini image build from e2e target prerequisites** <br> `Makefile-test.mk`|Five e2e targets (`test-multikueue-e2e-extended-*`, `test-e2e-extended-shard-0-*`, `test-e2e-extended-shard-2-*`, `test-tas-e2e-extended-shard-0-*`, `test-e2e-k8s-main-was`) remove the `kind-ray-project-mini-image-build` dependency from their prerequisite lists.|
|**Unconditionally pull Ray image when Kuberay is enabled** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|The `prepare_docker_images` function removes the `USE_RAY_FOR_TESTS == "ray"` conditional check, making the Ray image pull unconditional under the `KUBERAY_VERSION` install gate.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12135](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12135): Adjusts how `kind-ray-project-mini-image-build` builds the Ray mini image via platform selection.
- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12113](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12113): Changes e2e test target prerequisites to use `ray-project-mini-image-build-push` instead of the build target.
